name: 30345 · Atlanta, GA
findings: ZIP 30345 (Atlanta) has 137 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30345 (Atlanta) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30345 (Atlanta) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 44 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
